skill.name: interface-review
skill.description: Reviews interface changes across affected surfaces for UI, typography, layout, color, writing, and accessibility regressions.
skill.summary: Resolves change scope and delivers evidence-based interface findings with clear status and coverage.
skill.author: jakubkrehel

content.user_title: Review Interface Changes with Clear Evidence
content.value_statement: Interface changes can introduce visual, accessibility, and content regressions across connected surfaces. This skill resolves the change scope and produces evidence-based findings with clear status labels.
actual_capabilities: Resolves working tree, staged, branch, pull request, ref, and explicit range targets.
Excludes generated and vendor files while reporting every excluded path category.
Expands changed files to direct consumers and broader design-token surfaces.
Checks removed diff lines for accessibility, layout, typography, color, and writing regressions.
Classifies findings as introduced, regression, or pre-existing and reports review coverage.
limitations: Requires the companion better-interface skill for domain routing, severity, caps, and final verdicts.
Reviews at most five consumers unless broader expansion is required for shared primitives or tokens.
Does not replace correctness, security, performance, or test-focused code review.
Marks runtime and visual claims unverified unless rendered verification is requested or readily available.

use_cases.title: Review a feature branch
use_cases.description: Check interface changes across the branch and local edits before opening a pull request.

use_cases.title: Assess a pull request
use_cases.description: Resolve the pull request ref, inspect affected surfaces, and identify interface regressions.

use_cases.title: Verify accessibility changes
use_cases.description: Inspect removed semantics, focus behavior, labels, and motion preferences within the selected change.

prompt_templates.title: Review my current changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current interface changes. Resolve the default scope and report only introduced or regressed interface issues.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a working tree or branch

prompt_templates.title: Review a pull request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review pull request 482 for interface regressions. Include the resolved scope, affected surfaces, exclusions, coverage, and status for each finding.

prompt_templates.title: Review an explicit range
prompt_templates.prompt: Review release..feature as written. Check removed lines, expand affected consumers, and separate introduced, regressed, and pre-existing findings.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a shared design token change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this design token change across two consumer hops. Prioritize rendered entry points, explain coverage limits, and verify each claimed regression against the base.

output_examples.input: Review the current branch and include uncommitted interface changes.
output: Scope: seven commits and two uncommitted files against the default branch.
Coverage: twelve files after exclusions, with two affected surfaces reviewed.
Finding: a dialog lost its accessible name in this change. Status: Regression. Severity: High.
Verdict: Block until the accessible name is restored.

output_examples.input: Review pull request 482 for interface issues.
output: Scope: the fetched pull request head compared with its merge base.
Coverage: no interface evidence was found in excluded generated files.
No actionable interface findings were introduced or regressed.

best_practices: Name the target explicitly when you need a pull request, ref, branch, or range reviewed.
Provide the change intent so missing states and incomplete behavior can be evaluated.
Request rendered verification when findings depend on runtime behavior or visual output.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a whole-repository audit without routing directly to better-interface.
Do not treat pre-existing issues as failures caused by the current change.
Do not assume runtime or visual behavior was verified when the report marks it unverified.

faq.question: What change targets are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports working, staged, branch, pull request, bare ref, and explicit two-dot or three-dot ranges.

faq.question: Does it modify my working tree?
faq.answer: No. Reviews are read-only, and pull request refs are fetched without checkout.

faq.question: How are affected surfaces selected?
faq.answer: The skill expands direct consumers by default and may expand two hops for shared primitives, themes, and design tokens.

faq.question: Does it review every consumer?
faq.answer: No. It reviews at most five consumers and reports how many were not expanded.

faq.question: Can it perform visual verification?
faq.answer: Yes, when requested or when the project provides a cheap preview. Otherwise, visual and runtime claims remain unverified.

faq.question: Does it review security and performance?
faq.answer: No. It names those concerns once and directs them to the project general code review.
